
### Options

| Option | Description | Values |

| `action` | <string> | BUY, SELL, OCA, cancel |

| `quant` | The number of shares or contracts to buy or sell |  |

| `order_ref` | The order identifier that is unique among working orders |  |
| `attach_ref` | The order_ref of the parent order that must be filled before this order or a common identifier for orders in the same one-cancels-all (OCA) group. |  |
| `attached` | Submit attached parent/child orders together or OCA group of orders |  |
| `symbol` | The symbol of the contract to be traded, omit for OCA and bag orders |  |
| `market` | The market of the contract (might also be the name of the exchange) |  |
| `security_type` |  | STK, FUT, OPT |
| `currency` | <string> | EUR, GBP, AUD, NZD, USD, CAD, CHF, JPY |
| `multiplier` | The value of a single unit of change in price |  |
